description: A UI component named ProductCard for a LightningJS-based frontend, rendering product image, name, and price with reactive data binding.

classes.name: ProductCard
classes.description: A LightningJS component that displays product information such as image, name, and price, with support for reactive updates and navigation.

methods.name: Watcher: item(val)
methods.description: Updates component state (nameText, priceText, imageSrc, hasImage) based on the 'item' prop.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Initializes the component by invoking the item watcher to set up initial display.

methods.name: input.enter
methods.description: Handles user input (e.g., select or click) to navigate to the product detail page if item.id exists.
